headlines.text: On this day in 2020, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Omega & Page vs. The Young Bucks went to war, appearing on Revolution, rated 9.68 ? an all-timer. Widely hailed as the greatest tag team match in history and rated a full six stars out of five by the Wrestling Observer, this instant classic was named Match of the Year ? with real tension between the friends turned rivals, the crowd fully invested in every near-fall.

That Saturday in 2020, it was title-change night for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as Jon Moxley vs. Chris Jericho battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 7.16 ? a strong outing ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. For Jon Moxley, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. A dramatic title change ? Moxley absorbed a beating including a table powerbomb and a title-belt shot, but revealed midway through he'd been able to see through his supposedly-injured eye the whole time, capping the match with the Paradigm Shift to become AEW's second World Champion.
Looking back to 2020, when Darby Allin vs. Sammy Guevara locked horns for the first time on Revolution, rated 7.51 ? a solid showing.
